test_convert_tensor_to_py: test that C++ Eigen tensor functions return correct numpy arrays with expected writability
test_round_trip: test round-trip conversion of numpy arrays to C++ Eigen tensors and back
test_bad_cpp_to_python_casts: test that invalid C++ to Python tensor casts raise the correct RuntimeError
test_bad_python_to_cpp_casts: test that invalid numpy arrays passed to C++ tensor functions raise TypeError
test_reference_internal: test that reference_internal policy correctly increments and decrements Python object reference counts
